company.summary: Vytalyou是一家总部位于孟买的医生主导的长寿与预防性医疗健康初创公司，成立于2025年，将诊断、个性化健康干预和医疗监督护理相结合，提供预防性医疗和长寿服务。

"Doctor-led longevity and preventive healthcare startup Vytalyou has raised Rs 9 crore in a pre-Series A round from Chetan Jain of Pharma Dose and Ratan Jain of Venus Industries at a valuation of around Rs 33 crore. The proceeds will be used to expand its network of Incremental Lifestyle Clinics in Mumbai, Vytalyou said in a press release. Founded in 2025 by Chirantan Bose and Preetesh Bhandari, Vytalyou provides preventive healthcare and longevity-focused services, combining diagnostics with personalised health interventions and medically supervised care. The Mumbai-based startup offers services across pathology, radiology, cardio-respiratory assessments, body composition evaluation, genetic and cancer screening, gut microbiome evaluation, personalised IV therapies and regenerative interventions. It also offers non-invasive pain management technologies for chronic musculoskeletal conditions. Vytalyou uses an AI-based algorithm for its Predictive Longevity Evaluation, which assesses an individual&quot;s health profile, biological ageing and potential health risks. Doctors review the assessment and develop a medically supervised care plan based on the findings. The company said it has served close to 1,000 clients since opening its first centre, with around half coming through walk-ins and the rest through word-of-mouth referrals. It plans to expand to 10 locations across India in the coming years. Vytalyou operates in India&quot;s growing preventive healthcare and longevity segment, which has also seen startups such as Biopeak, Cent, Elevate Now and Decode Age raise capital. Biopeak raised $2.7 million in follow-on funding in January this year, while Cent, co-founded by Practo&quot;s Shashank ND, raised around $5 million for its AI-led early-detection platform covering cancer, cardiac, neurological and metabolic risks. Elevate Now raised Rs 18 crore in a seed round, while Decode Age raised Rs 14.48 crore in a pre-Series A round to expand its longevity research, biomarker discovery, multi-omics and microbiome capabilities. "

analysis.capital_judgment: 资本押注的核心变量是Vytalyou能否将医生主导的预防性长寿诊所模式从孟买单点扩展为多地点网络。当前融资所依赖的已验证信号包括：已服务近1000名客户、约一半来自直接到访、其余来自口碑推荐，以及本轮Rs 9 crore融资对应约Rs 33 crore估值。判断的证据边界在于：来源未披露客户留存率、单店经济模型、收入或利润数据，也未披露投资方对投资逻辑的公开表述，因此无法评估单位经济性和规模化复制能力。
